tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Find the download.fan page for a task: video downloaders (TikTok, Douyin, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, Twitter, Dailymotion, Snapchat), video/audio converters, image and PDF tools, a speed test, calculators, timers, unit converters, guides and official app download links. Returns up to five pages

tools.name: get_download_page
tools.description: Turn a public post URL from TikTok, Douyin, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, Twitter, Dailymotion, Snapchat into a download.fan link that opens with the post loaded, ready to save as MP4, MP3 or JPG. YouTube is not supported.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_download_page · Public sink: get_download_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_download_page · Public sink: get_download_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
